what.text: DHEA (dehydroepiandrosterone; drug name prasterone) is a steroid hormone made mainly by the adrenal glands. The body turns it into androgens and estrogens. In 14 older men, a single oral dose of DHEA raised estradiol and estrone but did not change testosterone.

what.text: DHEA is not FDA approved for men or for low testosterone. In the US it is sold as a supplement, which FDA does not review before sale.

research.text: DHEA has been tested in many randomized trials in older men. A 2013 meta-analysis of 25 placebo-controlled trials (1,353 men) found a small drop in fat mass and no effect on lipids, blood sugar, bone, sexual function or quality of life.

research.title: DHEA or testosterone in elderly people, 2 years (Nair et al.)

facts.v: 87 elderly men with low DHEA sulfate and low bioavailable testosterone (29 DHEA, 27 testosterone, 31 placebo) and 57 elderly women
physical performance, body composition, bone density, insulin sensitivity, quality of life

research.found: DHEA raised DHEA sulfate levels but did not change body composition, oxygen use, muscle strength, insulin sensitivity or quality of life. Men on DHEA had a rise in bone density at the hip (femoral neck). No major adverse effects.

src.label: Nair et al., N Engl J Med, 2006

research.title: DHEA vs oral testosterone for sexual problems (Morales et al.)

facts.v: 86 men with sexual dysfunction and low testosterone and/or DHEA; 79 completed
DHEA 50 mg twice a day, oral testosterone undecanoate, or placebo
erectile function (IIEF), androgen deficiency and aging male symptom scores, hormones, PSA

research.found: No differences between groups in sexual interest or erectile function on any of four questionnaires. DHEA levels rose in the DHEA group. PSA stayed stable.

src.label: Morales et al., Aging Male, 2009

research.title: DHEA vs androstenedione in trained middle-aged men (Wallace et al.)

facts.v: DHEA or androstenedione 50 mg twice a day, or placebo
body composition, strength, hormones, PSA, liver tests, lipids

research.found: Lean mass, strength and testosterone did not change more than with placebo. DHEA sulfate levels rose. No changes in PSA, liver tests or lipids were seen.

src.label: Wallace et al., Med Sci Sports Exerc, 1999

research.title: DHEA in elderly men: 25 placebo-controlled trials (Corona et al.)

facts.v: meta-analysis of double-blind, placebo-controlled randomized trials
body composition, lipids, blood sugar, bone, sexual function, quality of life

research.found: DHEA was linked to a small drop in fat mass, which disappeared after adjusting for the rise in testosterone and estradiol. No effect was seen on lipids, blood sugar, bone health, sexual function or quality of life.

src.label: Corona et al., J Clin Endocrinol Metab, 2013 (meta-analysis)

us.text: Prasterone is FDA approved only as Intrarosa (2016), a vaginal insert for painful sex due to menopause. DHEA is also sold as a dietary supplement, which FDA does not review before sale. It is not FDA approved for men or for low testosterone. As of November 1, 2026.

items.text: Intrarosa (prasterone) vaginal insert, NDA 208470, approved November 2016 for moderate to severe dyspareunia (painful sex), a symptom of vulvar and vaginal atrophy, due to menopause. Use of prasterone in men would be off-label.

items.lead: Not an anabolic steroid under US drug law:
items.text: the federal definition of “anabolic steroid” expressly leaves out dehydroepiandrosterone, so DHEA is not a controlled anabolic steroid in the US.

items.text: DHEA is listed in Category 1 (under evaluation) of FDA’s 503B bulk drug substance categories, marked as a component of an FDA-approved drug. Plain DHEA does not appear in the 503A categories; 7-keto DHEA is in 503A Category 1. Compounded drugs are not FDA approved.

world.lead: Prasterone is an approved medicine (Intrarosa, for women) in the US, Canada and the EU. Canada lists it as a controlled drug, the UK lists it as a Class C controlled drug, and Australia lists it as prescription only.

side.text: In the trials described here, DHEA did not cause major adverse effects, and PSA and liver tests did not change. DHEA is turned into estrogens as well as androgens.

items.text: in older men, oral DHEA raised estradiol and estrone in a dose-dependent way, without changing testosterone.

items.text: the 2-year trial found no major adverse effects. The 12-week trial in trained men found no changes in PSA, liver tests or lipids. The 2009 trial found PSA stable.

items.text: the most common side effect in 12-week trials was vaginal discharge (5.71% vs 3.66% on placebo); in a 52-week trial, vaginal discharge and abnormal Pap smear. The label notes that estrogen is a metabolite of prasterone and that Intrarosa has not been studied in women with a history of breast cancer.
